tex_content.html:
egin{claim} \end{claim}[Bochner formula for $| abla f|^2$] ↗ lem:laplacian-one-form

\[ riangle | abla f|^2 =2\langle abla riangle f, abla f angle +2\Ric ( abla f, abla f)+2|\Hess f|^2. \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:laplacian-one-form Apply the product rule to $\langle df,df angle $ and use $ riangle df=d riangle f+\Ric ( abla f,\cdot )$.

□
